title: Introducing Reflection Beam: an open-weight model for agentic coding on AWS
summary: Reflection AI's Beam is an open-weight model for agentic coding and long-horizon tasks. This post shows how to deploy Beam on AWS: start with an Amazon SageMaker JumpStart real-time endpoint, or use Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Inference with JumpStart, SGLang, or vLLM for Kubernete
